fixtures.origin: Synthetic AIXM 5.1.1 documents (or fragments of them) hand-written on 2026-09-21 for the refusal each exercises: a parser-safety attack the guarded parser refuses before expansion, a document outside the version or the root the adapter reads, a feature without the identifier identity is derived from, a geometry form outside the pinned profile (never approximated), a slice with no instant of its own, a rule breach the adapter refuses by name. Fictitious identifiers and positions throughout.
